records.benefit_summary: AWS says startups can apply for up to $200,000 in AWS Activate Credits for infrastructure, data services, and AI/ML models, including third-party models on Amazon Bedrock; amount depends on stage and eligibility tier.

records.program_status: Active; applications available

records.benefit_summary: Start tier offers up to $2,000 in Google Cloud credits valid for one year. Scale tier offers up to $200,000 in Google Cloud credits, or up to $350,000 for AI-first startups, plus Google Workspace Business Plus free for 12 months for new signups, Google Skills credits, and up to $12,000 in Enhanced Support credits for one year.
records.benefit_type: Cloud credits / AI credits / SaaS and support perks
records.eligibility: Start tier: technology startup planning to seek venture funding, founded within 24 months, no prior Google Cloud credits beyond free trial, and a defined product roadmap. Scale tier: VC-funded startup, generally pre-seed/seed within five years or Series A within 12 months, founded within five years, and not previously receiving more than $5,000 in Google Cloud credits. Google excludes acquired/IPO companies, educational institutions, government entities, nonprofits, consultancies/agencies, and certain other categories.
records.maximum_value: Up to 350,000 in Google Cloud credits for AI-first startups; additional Workspace, training, Maps, and support benefits
records.notes: Portugal eligibility is based on applying as a qualifying startup; the official page does not require the provider or startup to be headquartered in the same country. Google notes offers can change without notice and third-party model charges are not covered.
records.program_name: Google for Startups Cloud Program - Start and Scale tiers
records.program_status: Active; applications reviewed and approved by Google

records.benefit_summary: Microsoft advertises access to cutting-edge AI models, developer tools, and up to $150,000 in credits, with credits applicable across eligible Azure services from development through production workloads.

records.eligibility: Startup founders apply through the Microsoft for Startups portal; Microsoft evaluates eligibility and grants access to benefits. The official public page does not publish a Portugal-specific exclusion or a complete country list.

records.program_status: Active; join/application link available

records.benefit_summary: Financial support of €30,000 per startup for digital or technological, scalable business models, products, or services. The call describes €5,000 initial pre-financing, €20,000 advance, and €5,000 final payment.

records.eligibility: Young graduates up to age 29 developing idea-stage projects in technology-based areas, with focus on digital transition, innovation, qualified jobs, and SDG/ESG impact; detailed requirements are on the linked IAPMEI program page.

records.benefit_summary: Supports creation, development, and financing of a new business project. Funding request may be up to 85% of a maximum project amount of €200,000, implying a maximum requested support of €170,000 under the stated cap, subject to program approval and rules.
records.benefit_type: Business creation financing / grant and support
records.eligibility: Applicants must be over 18 and registered with IEFP, meet tax/social-security and other compliance requirements, present an economically and financially viable project, maintain activity and supported promoter employment for at least two years, and satisfy residence/status rules.
records.maximum_value: Up to 170,000 support request (85% of €200,000 maximum project amount)
records.notes: Startup Portugal's official page explicitly says applications are closed. The €170,000 figure is derived from the page's stated maximum request of 85% of €200,000; it is not described as a guaranteed award.
records.program_status: Closed

records.benefit_summary: Base deduction of 32.5% of eligible R&D expenditure plus an incremental rate of 50% of the increase over the average of the prior two years, capped at €1.5 million for the incremental component; ANI says the practical recovery can reach up to 82.5% of R&D investment.
records.eligibility: Companies carrying out qualifying R&D expenditure in Portugal and able to document projects and costs; application requires company identification, R&D project characterization, certified accountant declaration, expense map, IES, and Modelo 22. Eligibility and calculation are governed by applicable SIFIDE legislation.
records.maximum_value: Up to 82.5% of qualifying R&D investment in the stated practical example; incremental component capped at 1,500,000
records.notes: This is a Portugal-specific tax incentive rather than an upfront cash grant. The official ANI page provides the application mechanics and exact rates; no promo/referral code is relevant or published.
records.program_name: SIFIDE - Tax Incentive System for Business R&D
records.program_status: Active statutory application route; annual application deadline is end of the fifth month of the following year

records.benefit_summary: Portugal's public-backed venture investor identifies Portuguese startups with high growth and innovation potential as eligible investment targets; specific open-call amount and current call details were not exposed on the verified open-calls page.

records.program_status: Official applications/open-calls page exists; specific active call and amount not verifiable from retrieved page

records.benefit_summary: Partner-perks marketplace providing preferred access to startup benefits and discounts. For qualifying Scale and Scale AI members, AI21 Labs, Anthropic, and Mistral AI partner-model benefits may provide $10,000 in credits usable toward partner models in Model Garden.
records.country_or_region: Asia (eligible startups participating in Google for Startups Cloud Program; India excluded)
records.eligibility: Startups must join the Google for Startups Cloud Program; the cited $10,000 partner-model benefit is for qualifying Scale or Scale AI members and requires contacting a Google Cloud Account Executive. Other perks have their own provider terms.
records.maximum_value: $10,000 USD in partner-model credits for qualifying Scale/Scale AI members for the specified AI21 Labs, Anthropic, and Mistral AI benefits; other partner offers vary
records.notes: Google explicitly says perks are at the service provider’s discretion and redemption instructions are supplied through provider links or, for starred perks, through Google support. No universal promo code is published.
records.program_name: Google for Startups Cloud Program – Startup Perks
records.program_status: Active; redemption is provider-controlled and some perks are exclusive to Scale members

records.benefit_summary: Always-on AWS startup credit program: self-funded startups can receive up to $5,000, while startups backed by an AWS Activate Provider such as an accelerator, angel investor, or VC can receive up to $200,000. Additional $200,000+ AI credits are invite-only for startups ready to scale after Activate Portfolio.
records.country_or_region: Asia-Pacific and other regions where AWS is available; India excluded from this regional research row
records.eligibility: Generally pre-Series B, founded within the last 10 years, on an AWS paid-tier account, and either new to Activate credits or requesting more than previously received. Portfolio tier requires an Organization ID from an AWS Activate Provider.
records.maximum_value: Up to $200,000 USD for Activate Portfolio; up to $5,000 USD for self-funded Activate Founders; $200,000+ additional AI credits invite-only
records.notes: AWS uses provider Organization IDs for portfolio applications, but the page does not publish a universal promo/referral code. Credits are promotional credits subject to AWS terms and can offset infrastructure, data, and AI/ML usage, including eligible third-party models on Bedrock.
records.program_status: Active; applications open and AWS says decisions usually arrive within 5-10 business days

records.benefit_summary: Microsoft for Startups provides Azure Startup credits, AI capabilities, technical guidance, and go-to-market resources, with up to $150,000 in Startup credits over time as the company demonstrates verified progress, service adoption, and sustained Azure usage.
records.benefit_type: Cloud/API/AI credits; SaaS/developer tools; go-to-market support
records.code_status: No public code verified; official page mentions only partner-specific Investor Network referral codes
records.country_or_region: Asia (headquartered in countries where Azure services are available; India excluded)
records.eligibility: Privately held, for-profit software product/service companies that own their product; headquartered where Azure is available; not beyond Series C; not exceeding $350,000 lifetime free Azure credits; excludes educational institutions, governments, consultancies/agencies, and cryptocurrency mining.
records.maximum_value: Up to $150,000 USD in Azure Startup credits
records.notes: The official documentation says every startup applies through the website and applications are typically reviewed within three business days. A referral code may be entered if supplied by a Microsoft for Startups Investor Network partner, but Microsoft does not publish a general code.
records.program_status: Active; direct applications open

records.benefit_summary: Three-month equity-free accelerator for AI startups, with dedicated Google and industry experts, specialist technical and business deep dives, early access to AI products, Google product credits, Cloud TPU access, technical project partnership, investor showcases, and access to Google Cloud infrastructure. Credits require separate eligibility review.
records.benefit_type: Equity-free accelerator; cloud/API/AI credits; technical and investor support
records.country_or_region: Southeast Asia (Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines; India excluded)
records.eligibility: AI-product startups headquartered in Southeast Asia, ideally Seed to Series B, with a launched product and user traction, scalable/defensible model, full-time founders, and substantial in-house technical/AI capability. Participation is equity-free; founders and technical leads must commit to program sessions.
records.maximum_value: Up to $350,000 USD in Google Cloud credits under the linked Google for Startups Cloud Program; accelerator’s own product-credit amount is not separately stated
records.notes: The official page explicitly separates accelerator product credits from Cloud credits and says Cloud credits are subject to eligibility review and approval. The page lists the 2026 application dates and confirms no equity or participation fee.
records.program_name: Google for Startups Accelerator: Southeast Asia 2026
records.program_status: Applications closed June 20, 2026; inaugural cohort scheduled to run August-early November 2026

records.benefit_summary: Three-week AWS program for pre-seed and seed generative-AI startups with an MVP, offering technical deep dives, AWS engineering and industry expertise, executive/go-to-market advisors, investor and partner networking, and access to AWS Activate credits for eligible participants.
records.benefit_type: AI accelerator; technical and go-to-market support; linked cloud credits
records.country_or_region: Asia-Pacific and Japan, specifically Australia, New Zealand, ASEAN countries, Korea and Japan (India excluded)
records.eligibility: Pre-seed and seed generative-AI startups headquartered in Australia, New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines), Korea or Japan; MVP-ready or in-market with early customers and technical leadership. India is listed on the historical page but excluded from this research row.
records.maximum_value: Unknown for the accelerator itself; participants must also qualify for AWS Activate credits, which currently offer up to $5,000 self-funded or up to $200,000 portfolio credits
records.notes: Included as a strong regional record but clearly marked closed/concluded. The page says startups must also qualify for AWS Activate; it does not state a separate cash grant or fixed accelerator credit amount.
records.program_status: Concluded/closed: official page lists the 2025 application window (April 7-May 9, 2025) and June 2025 program schedule; no current cohort dates shown

regions.region: Asia (excluding India and country-specific rows already covered)
